cpsFeature.note: The chrome-platform-showcase suite at conformanceRoute governs only the assertions it explicitly lists; it does not prove unasserted native, hardware, permission, backend, or other behavior. gendn references that listed contract without forking it.

assertions.describe: The stable route /v151/capability-elements-usermedia-mvp/ responds 200 (durable-demo contract).
Page carries its canonical chromestatus.com/feature/4926233538330624 link — the immutable feature identity (CLAUDE.md invariant #3) and the milestone-151 mapping's self-heal.
Document has a non-empty <title> for the reference page.
Exactly one <h1> — the API name (listing name), MDN-shaped article heading.
A single <main> landmark wraps the article content.
Shared editorial design system /public/styles.css is linked.
Responsive viewport meta present (width=device-width) for mobile+desktop parity.
Breadcrumb links back to the /v151/ release index.
Byline footer present (article provenance).
Every target=_blank link carries rel=noopener (no reverse-tabnabbing; MDN-style external link hygiene).
No anchor has an empty or placeholder (#) href.
assertions.test: [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].every(el => { const h = el.getAttribute('href'); return h && h !== '#'; })

assertions.describe: Page loads with no console errors.
No failed (>=400 / net-error) network requests on load.
No unintended horizontal overflow at desktop (1280x800).
No unintended horizontal overflow at narrow mobile (360x740, DPR3).
Desktop render is legible, contrast passes WCAG AA, controls/text not clipped (screenshot review).
Mobile render is legible with adequate tap targets and no clipped text/controls (screenshot review).
The <h1> is the chromestatus milestone-listing name for this feature (not the broader detail name) — factual/source fidelity.
Frontend implementation consulted modern-web-guidance for its UI/responsive/a11y topics and applied or justified them (recorded in _questions.json guidanceConsulted).
Built reference has at least three <h2> sections (MDN-shaped depth).
Cross-browser support is documented (a support/compat/baseline section, or a reference table stating Baseline / Shipped-in / standards positions) — accurate messaging, not implied support.
Built reference includes a usable example surface (<pre> code and/or a live embed).
Code/IDL examples are correctly escaped (no attribute/element injection, invariant #4) and trace to the cited spec/IDL — no invented members (source review).
Experimental / origin-trial / behind-a-flag feature shows the mandatory .warn-block with enable steps (CLAUDE.md invariant #7).

Embedded live example points at THIS feature's chrome-platform-showcase route (chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v151/capability-elements-usermedia-mvp...) — the canonical demo identity, never repointed.

The embedded chrome-platform-showcase demo actually renders (not a blank box or error frame); its platform behavior is governed by the CPS conformance contract referenced in cpsFeature, not re-asserted here.
The pre-correction route /v150/capability-elements-usermedia-mvp/ 301-redirects to this corrected milestone route (move migration keeps old inbound links alive).
The earlier pre-correction route /v149/capability-elements-usermedia-mvp/ still 301-redirects (existing 2026-07-19 move migration; chains to the current route via the v150 record).
The stable member routes (properties/, setconstraints/, events/) resolve 200 and render the nine-dimension anchors declared by reference-contract.json.
assertions.test: (async () => { const need = { 'properties/': ['syntax','inputs','outputs-stream','outputs-error','errors','context','lifecycle','examples','compatibility','security-privacy'], 'setconstraints/': ['syntax','inputs','outputs-method','outputs-dictionary','errors','context','lifecycle','examples','compatibility','security-privacy'], 'events/': ['syntax','inputs','outputs-stream','outputs-cancel','outputs-error','errors','context','lifecycle','examples-stream','examples-cancel','examples-error','compatibility','security-privacy'] }; for (const [route, ids] of Object.entries(need)) { const r = await fetch('./' + route); if (r.status !== 200) return false; const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await r.text(), 'text/html'); for (const i of ids) { const el = doc.getElementById(i); if (!el || el.parentElement.textContent.trim().length < 40) return false; } } return true; })()

assertions.describe: The overview links every stable member route (implementation-sufficiency: overview explains the model and links every item).
The normative spec section (mediacapture-extensions #media-capture-html-elements — the feature record's spec_link) is directly linked.
Both vendor-signal sources (mozilla/standards-positions #1392 — under consideration; WICG/PEPC #62 — WebKit no signal) are directly linked.
All four shipping Chromium IDL files (element, base mixin, stream partial mixin, constraints partial mixin) are directly linked — the ground-truth shipping surface.
Executable doc-quality check: the overview documents the SHIPPING MVP shape — readonly stream, setConstraints(), and stream/cancel/error events (not the superseded draft).
assertions.test: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('main').textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' '); return /readonly attribute MediaStream\? stream/.test(t) && /setConstraints\(optional HTMLMediaStreamConstraints/.test(t) && /onstream/.test(t) && /oncancel/.test(t) && /onerror/.test(t); })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: the superseded WICG/PEPC draft shape (permissionconstraints, autostart, enabled, streamready/userchangedenabled) is explicitly flagged as not shipping, so readers of early docs are corrected.
assertions.test: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('superseded-draft'); if (!el) return false; const t = el.parentElement.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' '); return /permissionconstraints/.test(t) && /autostart/.test(t) && /streamready/.test(t) && /None of that ships in Chrome 151/.test(t); })()

assertions.describe: The experimental legacy migration surface (UserMediaElementLegacy) is documented with its own nine-dimension anchors and an explicit experimental/deprecation framing.
Both compatibility fragments (element + legacy) are real tables with explicit cells (BCD absence and upstream WPT coverage recorded, not omitted).
assertions.test: (() => { const a = document.getElementById('compatibility')?.parentElement.querySelector('table'); const b = document.getElementById('legacy-compatibility')?.parentElement.querySelector('table'); if (!a || !b) return false; const t = a.textContent; return /No entry/.test(t) && /Upstream WPT coverage exists/.test(t); })()

assertions.describe: The identity-matched chrome-platform-showcase FEATURE route (chromestatus 4926233538330624) is directly linked (embed governance per cpsFeature; not repointed to another feature).
